# T-cells

## Validate gate names, coordinates and populations

### Load workspace and set up design
```{r load flowJo workspace}
wsfile = file.path(fcsDir, "T cell panel/T cell_hierarchical and ALL parameter gating/2024-05-14 D4/2024-05-14_Tpanel_gating_debarcoded_exp_ICs_all_batches_D4.wsp")
ws = open_flowjo_xml(wsfile)

summary(ws)

gs_flowJo = flowjo_to_gatingset(ws, 
                                  skip_faulty_gate = TRUE, 
                                  name = 1,
                                  path = file.path(fcsDir, "T cell panel/T panel_FCS files_exported de-barcoded"))

plot(gs_flowJo)


# nodelist = gs_get_pop_paths(gs_flowJo, path = 1)
nodelist = gs_get_pop_paths(gs_flowJo, path = "full")
print(nodelist)

```

```{r load the annotations}
annotations_ = read_excel("tables/annotation_cleaned.xlsx", sheet = 1)

# add a column ALid that is "AL" + the number, make sure the number is three digits, with leading zeros if needed
annotations_$ALId = paste0("AL", formatC(as.numeric(annotations_$Alnumber), width = 3, format = "d", flag = "0"))
annotations_ = dplyr::select(annotations_, -Alnumber)

annotations_2 = read_excel("tables/annotation_cleaned.xlsx", sheet = 2)

setdiff(annotations_2$testId, annotations_$testId)

annotations = merge(annotations_, annotations_2, by = "testId", all.x = TRUE, all.y = TRUE) 

missingAL = dplyr::filter(annotations, is.na(ALId))
annotations = dplyr::filter(annotations, !is.na(ALId))

```

```{r create the design matrix}
fcsFiles = list.files(file.path(fcsDir, "T cell panel/T panel_FCS files_exported de-barcoded"), pattern = ".fcs$", full.names = TRUE)

# remove exp_A_DMSO_only_B07_IC07.fcs from fcsFiles. I think this was created by accident?
fcsFiles = fcsFiles[!str_detect(fcsFiles, "exp_A_DMSO_only_B07_IC07.fcs")]

design = data.frame(fcsFiles = fcsFiles)

design$fcsName = basename(design$fcsFiles)
design$sampleName = gsub(".fcs", "", design$fcsName)
```

```{r add annotations to the design matrix}
# extract ALnumber from design$sample_name
design$ALId = gsub(".*AL([0-9]+).*", "AL\\1", design$sample)

design$control = str_detect(design$sampleName, "IC")
design$ALId[design$control] = NA

design = merge(design, annotations, by = "ALId", all.x = TRUE)

setdiff(annotations$ALId, design$ALId)
```

```{r add batch ID to design matrix}

# add batch ID to design matrix:
design$batch = as.numeric(gsub(".*B([0-9]+).*", "\\1", design$sampleName))

# identify conditions, by splitting sample name by _ and taking the third element
design$condition = sapply(strsplit(design$sampleName, "_"), function(x) x[3])
design$experiment = sapply(strsplit(design$sampleName, "_"), function(x) x[2])

# make condition long if condition DM = DMSO, SP = Spike, CE = CEFX and MN = MN
design$conditionLong =  ifelse(design$condition == "DM", "DMSO", 
                        ifelse(design$condition == "SP", "spike", 
                        ifelse(design$condition == "CE", "CEFX", 
                               design$condition) ) ) 


table(design$condition)
table(design$batch, design$condition)
table(design$control, design$condition)
table(design$ALId)

```

## Setup gates


```{r try to work through the gating}
gateList = data.frame(flowJoName = nodelist)

# write to csv so I can open in excel and figure out a pattern
write.csv(gateList, file = "tables/Tcell_gateList.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# There appear to be 3 "levels" of nodes. We start with a topLevel path
# /LYM/BC/Live that all of our populations relate to
topLevel = c("LYM", "BC", "Live")

# after that comes a set of X nodes that are all applied to that level

# then we go into CD4/CD8 specific gating. For that we append CD3+dump-/NKT/TCRgd+ to the toplevel
# /LYM/BC/Live/CD3+dump-/NKT/TCRgd+
CD48 = c("CD3+ dump-", "NKT", "TCRgd+")

# then we have the CD4+ specific gating
# /LYM/BC/Live/CD3+dump-/NKT/TCRgd+/CD4+/Treg/ and /LYM/BC/Live/CD3+dump-/NKT/TCRgd+/CD4+/CXCR3_dim+
# I wonder if /LYM/BC/Live/CD3+dump-/NKT/TCRgd+/CD4+/CXCR3_dim+ is a mistake and shouldn't be there - because it is the only gate that appears multiple times
# and breaks the code from last time
# and then we also have CD8 specific paths: /LYM/BC/Live/CD3+dump-/NKT/TCRgd+/CD8+/CD8_RA+ and /LYM/BC/Live/CD3+dump-/NKT/TCRgd+/CD8+/CD8_RO+
# I think I will add different levels of depth to the gating list, so that I should just be able to loop through the list


# For gating now, the easiest path is going to be to start at the top of the list, and subsequently add the next level of nodes to the path
# gateList = dplyr::filter(gateList, flowJoName == "root") # Since we read in the gates in a loop like i=2:len(nodes) and indexed gates[i], we can't remove the root from the list

# str split flowJoName by "/" and take the last element
gateList$node = sapply(strsplit(gateList$flowJoName, "/"), function(x) x[length(x)])
gateList$parent = sapply(strsplit(gateList$flowJoName, "/"), function(x) paste0(x[1:(length(x) - 1)], collapse = "/"))
gateList$parent[gateList$parent == ""] = "root"

gateList = dplyr::filter(gateList, node != "root")
```


```{r get gates and transformations}
# get the controls
samples = data.frame(flowJoName = sampleNames(gs_flowJo) )
# remove the _95977 from exp_D_MN_B04_IC04.fcs_95977, etc
samples$fcsName = gsub(".fcs_.*", ".fcs", samples$flowJoName)

samples = merge(samples, design, by = "fcsName")


table(samples$condition, samples$batch)

```

```{r generate gate and transformer lists}
# start building out gates

# IMPORTANT: the first time I ran the evaluation I had issues with the not gates. I will correctly handle them in the next section. HOWEVER - the big problem is how they are coming out of the workspace, eg. NKT in the gating paths should actually be NKT- and the gate that has filterId NKT is actually NKT+! So I am going to have to fix the gate names in the gating objects, but more importantly, we will have to replace all the NKTs in paths to NKT-. And it gets even worse TCRgd+ in the gating paths is actually TCRgd- and the gate that has filterId TCRgd+ is actually TCRgd+! So I will have to fix that as well. 

gates = list()
trans = list()
for (condition_ in unique(design$condition)) {
  gates[[condition_]] = list()
  trans[[condition_]] = list()
}

for (iControl in 1:nrow(samples)) {
  condition_ = samples$condition[iControl]
  batch_ = samples$batch[iControl]
  
  #Get the gates for this condition and batch
  gates_ = list()
  for (i in 1:nrow(gateList)) {
    gates_[[i]] = gs_pop_get_gate(gs_flowJo, gateList$flowJoName[i])[[iControl]]
  }
  gates[[condition_]][[batch_]] = gates_
  
  # Get transformations for this condition and batch
  trans_ = gh_get_transformations(gs_flowJo[[iControl]])
  trans[[condition_]][[batch_]] <- transformList(from = names(trans_), trans_)
}
```


```{r explore the NKT gate}
# The first pass of the validation, I noticed that all gates after NKT are off. So let's go find out what is going on.
gateList$flowJoName[gateList$node == "NKT"]
idx = which(gateList$node == "NKT")

gate_ = gates[[1]][[1]][[idx]]
gate_

# Looking into 2024-04-30_Tpanel-Gating Tree.pdf it seems that NKT and TCRgd+ are both not gates.
# I don't understand why flowJo is not storing these correctly, but I will add them to the list of nodes


```



```{r handling the not gates NKT}
# gatesBackup = gates
# gateListBackup = gateList
# gates = gatesBackup
# gateList = gateListBackup

# first not gate is NKT - instead of separating these,  could write that in a loop/function
# but since this is the first time doing this, I will do it manually
idx = which(gateList$node == "NKT")
gate_ = gates[[1]][[1]][[idx]]
gate_

gatesObject = gates[[1]][[1]]


filterIdpos = "NKT+" 
filterIdneg = "NKT-"


parent = gateList$parent[idx]

flowJoNamePos = paste(parent, filterIdpos, sep = "/")
flowJoNameNeg = paste(parent, filterIdneg, sep = "/")

# inside the gateList, replace all instances of NKT with NKT-
# Important: we do this first so that we replace all of them for now, and then we 
# will replace the one NKT that should be NKT+ but got turned into NKT- with flowJoNamePos
gateList$flowJoName = gsub("NKT", "NKT-", gateList$flowJoName)
gateList$parent = gsub("NKT", "NKT-", gateList$parent)

gateList$flowJoName[idx] = flowJoNamePos
gateList$node[idx] = filterIdpos

# insert NKTgate into the gate list and the gate object
# we have to insert after the NKT gate to make sure that when we sequentially gate it the NKT+ gate is there
gateList = rbind(gateList[1:idx,], data.frame(flowJoName = flowJoNameNeg, node = filterIdneg, parent = parent), gateList[(idx+1):nrow(gateList),])

# setup the gate that will be inserted
filterChar = paste0("`!", filterIdpos, "`")
filterExpression = parse(text = filterChar)[[1]]

# Build the not gate
exprs <- paste0("!", filterIdpos)
gate_ = eval(substitute(booleanFilter(v, filterId = w), list(v = as.symbol(exprs), w = filterIdneg)))

# after updating the gate list, we need to update the gates object
for (condition_ in unique(design$condition)) {
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    # update the filter name of the gate object
    gatesObject = gates[[condition_]][[batch_]]
    gatesObject[[idx]]@filterId = filterIdpos

    # insert the additional logical gate into the gates object
    gatesObject = c(gatesObject[1:idx], list(gate_), gatesObject[(idx+1):length(gatesObject)])
    
    gates[[condition_]][[batch_]] = gatesObject
  }
}


```

### Transform fcs and setup validation gating sets


```{r transform fcs files}
fcs_transformed_directory = file.path(fcsDir, "transformed_flow_data", "T_cell_panel")

design$transformedFcs = file.path(fcs_transformed_directory, design$fcsName)

# The first time I analyze this data set, I am actually loading and transforming the data

paths_ = unique(dirname(design$transformedFcs))
for (path_ in paths_) {
  dir.create(path_, showWarnings = F, recursive = T)
}

# Everytime we get a new gating set/workspace, we need to transform the fcs files again.
for (iRow in 1:nrow(design)) {
  print(iRow)
  if (file.exists(design$transformedFcs[iRow])) {
    next
  }
  ff = read.FCS(design$fcsFiles[iRow], truncate_max_range = TRUE)
  # ff = read.FCS(design$fcs_file[iRow], truncate_max_range = FALSE)
  ff_t = flowCore::transform(ff, trans[[design$condition[iRow]]][[design$batch[iRow]]])
  
  write.FCS(ff_t, file = design$transformedFcs[iRow])
}

```


```{r read in the counts from amber}
# This time, Amber did not get event counts for all individual files. So instead of making gating sets that contain "all" files, 
# I can read in her count list first, and then use only samples that she used to build gating sets.
# This way creating the gating sets will be much faster and I can still make all the comparisons needed

counts_amber = read_csv("tables/T_cell_root_and_all_pars_counts_D4.csv")
# Remember, later we will need to replace all paths of NKT with NKT- and TCRgd+ with TCRgd-, Treg with Treg- in the counts_amber data frame

```

```{r setup gating sets}
# After organizing the gates, we need to organize the fcs files into gating sets
# instead of making folders and using symboling links (cyto_setup needs a folder to read files in)
# let's see if we can build the gs objects with flowCore (flowSet() and GatingSet() )

gs = list()
for (condition_ in unique(design$condition)) {
  gs[[condition_]] = list()
}

for (condition_ in unique(design$condition)) {
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    samples_ = dplyr::filter(design, condition == condition_, batch == batch_)
    # add a second filtering step to only keep files that amber tested on
    samples_ = dplyr::filter(samples_, fcsName %in% counts_amber$sample)
    
    
    print(paste0("group: ", condition_, " batch: ", batch_, " samples: ", nrow(samples_)))
    flowSet = read.flowSet(samples_$transformedFcs,
                           truncate_max_range = FALSE)
    
    gs[[condition_]][[batch_]] = GatingSet(flowSet)
  }
}
```

### Do gating

```{r gate all the gates amber gave us}
# this is a bit different than in previous iterations - now, instead of going by "hierarchical" and 
# "leafs" I am going to just step through sequentially

for (condition_ in unique(design$condition)) {
  for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
    for (i in 1:nrow(gateList) ) {
      gs_pop_add(gs[[condition_]][[batch_]], gates[[condition_]][[batch_]][[i]], parent = gateList$parent[i])
    }

}
```

### Validation with FlowJO counts
```{r compare the results to Ambers counts}


merged_pop_counts_ = dplyr::select(pop_counts, fcsName = name, population = Population, countR = Count)

counts_amber_long = counts_amber %>% 
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "population", values_to = "count_amber")

counts_amber_long = dplyr::select(counts_amber_long, fcsName = sample, population, countAmber = count_amber )

# ambers counts are missing the leading /
symdiff(counts_amber_long$population, merged_pop_counts_$population, )

counts_amber_long$population = paste0("/", counts_amber_long$population)

# now we should only have "/Count" missing. this would be equal to our "root"
# and also the PB+ gate (which Amber did not write out)
symdiff(counts_amber_long$population, merged_pop_counts_$population)

# lots still missing - remember, we need to replace NKT and TCRgd+
counts_amber_long$population = gsub("NKT", "NKT-", counts_amber_long$population)
counts_amber_long$population = gsub("TCRgd\\+", "TCRgd-", counts_amber_long$population)
counts_amber_long$population = gsub("Treg", "Treg-", counts_amber_long$population)

symdiff(counts_amber_long$population, merged_pop_counts_$population)
# Now we are only missing the NKT+ and TCRgd+ gates and the /LYM/BC/Live/CD3+dump-/NKT-/TCRgd-/CD4+/CXCR3_dim+ gate that I think shouldn't be in the flowJo workspace

merged_pop_counts = left_join(merged_pop_counts_, counts_amber_long, by = c("fcsName", "population"))

# removing amber counts with NA, will remove the PB+ nodes
merged_pop_counts = dplyr::filter(merged_pop_counts, !is.na(countAmber))

```

## IMPACD gating

```{r set up functions to keep code cleaner}

# setup gating set
getGatingSet = function(design) {
  gs = list()
  for (condition_ in unique(design$condition)) {
    gs[[condition_]] = list()
  }
  
  for (condition_ in unique(design$condition)) {
    for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
      samples_ = dplyr::filter(design, condition == condition_, batch == batch_)
      
      print(paste0("group: ", condition_, " batch: ", batch_, " samples: ", nrow(samples_)))
      flowSet = read.flowSet(samples_$transformedFcs,
                             truncate_max_range = FALSE)
      
      gs[[condition_]][[batch_]] = GatingSet(flowSet)
    }
  }
  
  return(gs)
}

# gate for the rootpath - rootPathGates must be in the same order that you want the rootpath to be in
getRootPathTcells = function(gs, design, gates, rootPathGates) {
  
  for (condition_ in unique(design$condition)) {
    for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
      for (i in 1:nrow(rootPathGates) ) {
        gs_pop_add(gs[[condition_]][[batch_]], gates[[condition_]][[batch_]][[rootPathGates$idx[i]]], parent = rootPathGates$parent[i])
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(gs)
}

# level1 gating
gateLevel1 = function(gs, design, level1_gates, level1_nodes, gatemetadata, root_path) {
  # do the stage 1 gating
  for (condition_ in unique(design$condition)) {
    for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
      message(paste0("Stage 1 gating for batch ", batch_, " in group ", condition_))
      level1_paths = level1Gating(gs[[condition_]][[batch_]], 
                                  level1_nodes, 
                                  gatemetadata, level1_gates[[condition_]][[batch_]], 
                                  root_path) 
    }
  }
  
  return(gs)
}

# permutational gating
gateIMPACD = function(gs, design, level1_gates, level1_nodes, gatemetadata, root_path) {
  population_counts = list()
  for (condition_ in unique(design$condition)) {
    # population_counts[[condition_]] = list()
    
    for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
      message(paste0("Stage 2 gating for batch ", batch_, " in group ", condition_))
      level2_paths = level2Gating(gs[[condition_]][[batch_]], 
                                  level1_nodes, gatemetadata, level1_gates[[condition_]][[batch_]], 
                                  root_path,
                                  max_depth = 3,
                                  level1_nodes = level1_nodes,
                                  cellcountCutoff = 0) 
      
      # pop_counts_ = gs_pop_get_count_fast(gs[[condition_]][[batch_]], format = "long")
      # population_counts[[condition_]][[batch_]] = pop_counts_
    }
  }
  
  return(gs)
}

getRawCounts = function(gs, design) {
  population_counts = list()
  for (condition_ in unique(design$condition)) {
    population_counts[[condition_]] = list()
    for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
      pop_counts_ = gs_pop_get_count_fast(gs[[condition_]][[batch_]], format = "long")
      population_counts[[condition_]][[batch_]] = pop_counts_
    }
  }
  
  counts = c()
  for (condition_ in unique(design$condition)) {
    counts_ = bind_rows(population_counts[[condition_]])
    counts_$condition = condition_
    counts = rbind(counts, counts_)
  }
  counts$PercentParent = counts$Count/counts$ParentCount*100
  counts$PercentParent[is.na(counts$PercentParent)] = NA

  return(counts)
}

processGatingPaths = function(summary, max_depth = 1) {

  columns = colnames(summary)

  if (!"path" %in% columns) {
    summary$path = summary$Population
  }

  # determine gating depth for each population
  summary$depth = str_count(summary$path, "/")

  # determine gating depth of the root path
  root_path_length = max(summary$depth)-max_depth

  # split all gating paths into a matrix so that gating results can be more
  # easily extracted later
  pathing = str_split(str_remove(summary$path, '^/'), "/", simplify = TRUE)

  # determine the root path
  # root_path = paste(pathing[nrow(summary), 1:root_path_length], collapse = "/")
  # summary$root_node = root_path

  # determine terminal node
  summary$terminal_node = pathing[cbind(1:nrow(pathing), summary$depth)]

  # determine gating depth after root path
  summary$depth = summary$depth - root_path_length

  # No need to extract modifiers if max_depth is 1
  if (max_depth == 1) {return(summary)}

  # determine what the maximum number of modifiers must have been
  max_modifiers = max_depth -1

  # determine all modifiers and add columns for them, will generate columns of
  # the type modifier_1, modifier_2, ... up to the maximum number of modifiers
  for (i_modifier in 1:max_modifiers ){
    column_name = paste0("modifier", "_", i_modifier)

    summary[[column_name]] = ""

    idx = which(summary$depth>i_modifier)

    summary[idx, column_name] = pathing[cbind(idx, root_path_length+i_modifier)]
  }

  return(summary)
}

assignRoot = function(nodes, rootPaths) {
  # Escape both + and - signs in rootPaths
  escaped_rootPaths <- sapply(rootPaths, function(path) {
      path <- str_replace_all(path, "\\+", "\\\\+")  # Escape +
      path <- str_replace_all(path, "\\-", "\\\\-")  # Escape -
      return(path)
    })
  
  # Create a new column in counts
  nodes <- nodes %>%
    rowwise() %>%  # rowwise to evaluate for each row
    mutate(
      rootPath = {
        match <- sapply(names(escaped_rootPaths), function(x) {
          # Match complete paths (followed by a '/' or end of string '$')
          str_detect(path, paste0(escaped_rootPaths[[x]], "(/|$)"))
        })
        if(any(match)) {
          names(escaped_rootPaths)[which(match)[1]]  # Return the first match's name from rootPaths
        } else {
          NA  # No match found
        }
      },
      # Remove the rootPath portion from Population to get pathInCompartment
      pathInCompartment = ifelse(!is.na(rootPath), 
                                 str_remove(path, paste0(escaped_rootPaths[rootPath], "(/|$)")), 
                                 NA)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()  # undo rowwise
  
  return (nodes)
  
} 


convertToMatrix = function(counts, depths = c(1, 2, 3)) {
  counts = dplyr::filter(counts, depth %in% depths)
  
  pctParent =     spread(dplyr::select(counts, sampleName, PercentParent, subset), key = sampleName, value = PercentParent)
  parentCounts =  spread(dplyr::select(counts, sampleName, ParentCount,   subset), key = sampleName, value = ParentCount)
  popCounts =     spread(dplyr::select(counts, sampleName, Count,         subset), key = sampleName, value = Count)
  
  rownames(pctParent) = pctParent$subset
  rownames(parentCounts) = parentCounts$subset
  rownames(popCounts) = popCounts$subset
  
  pctParent = dplyr::select(pctParent, -subset)
  parentCounts = dplyr::select(parentCounts, -subset)
  popCounts = dplyr::select(popCounts, -subset)
  
  return(list(pctParent = pctParent, parentCounts = parentCounts, popCounts = popCounts))
}
```

```{r setup leafnodes}
  }

# Besides the list of gates, we also need a gate "metadata frame". Below is the example from
# the IMPACD documentation. Since we aren't going to use the metadata for building the gates,
# we can make most columns NAs, we will just need the logical "gate" column, which, fortunately for us
# is going to be all FALSE, since the only logical gate (PB) is part of the root path 
# and was handled outside of IMPACD
# head(gate_data)
# name gate_type marker1 marker2 original_gate_position logical_gate transformed_gate_position
# 1 CD49b+        1D Dy161Di             76.400000000000006        FALSE              c(138.34....
# 2 CD49b-        1D Dy161Di             76.400000000000006        FALSE              c(138.34....
gatemetadata = data.frame(name = level1_nodes, 
                          gate_type = "2D", 
                          marker1 = NA, 
                          marker2 = NA, 
                          original_gate_position = NA, 
                          logical_gate = FALSE, 
                          transformed_gate_position = NA)
```

```{r subset info}
subsetNameAntigenSpecific = "non-TFH_Th1_17_AIM++"
```

```{r previous}
# First, we need to add the CXCR5- gate to our data structures
nodesToAdd = c("CXCR5") # nodes that need to be negated

filterIdpos = paste0(nodesToAdd, "+")
filterIdneg = paste0(nodesToAdd, "-")

idx = which(gateList$node %in% filterIdpos)

parent = gateList$parent[idx]

flowJoNamePos = paste(parent, filterIdpos, sep = "/")
flowJoNameNeg = paste(parent, filterIdneg, sep = "/")

# setup the gate that will be inserted
filterChar = paste0("`!", filterIdpos, "`")

for (i in 1:length(nodesToAdd)) {
  
  if (filterIdneg[i] %in% gateList$node) {next}
  
  exprs = paste0("!", filterIdpos[i])
  gate_ = eval(substitute(booleanFilter(v, filterId = w), list(v = as.symbol(exprs), w = filterIdneg[i])))
  
  gateList = rbind(gateList, data.frame(flowJoName = flowJoNameNeg[i], node = filterIdneg[i], parent = parent[i], idx = nrow(gateList)+1 ))
  
  for (condition_ in unique(design$condition)) {
    for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
      gates[[condition_]][[batch_]] = c(gates[[condition_]][[batch_]], gate_)
    }
  }
  
}

gateList$flowJoName[1:14]

# rootpath
rootPathGates = rbind(gateList[c(1:11,13,14),], dplyr::filter(gateList, node %in% c("CD4_RO+") )) # root path for the CD4+ RO+ cells

# now add the non-THF Th1_17 node
newNodes = c("CXCR5+", "CXCR5-", "CXCR3+", "CCR6+") # the negative node must be next to the positive of its kind
rootPathGates = rbind(rootPathGates, gateList[match(newNodes, gateList$node), ])

for (i in 1:length(newNodes)) {
  idx = which(rootPathGates$node == newNodes[i])
  if (str_detect(newNodes[i], "-") ) { # if is a negative gate, we will take the root path from two above.
      rootPathGates$parent[idx] = rootPathGates$parent[idx-1]
    } else { # else we take the node name
      rootPathGates$parent[idx] = rootPathGates$flowJoName[idx-1]
    } 
  rootPathGates$flowJoName[idx] = paste0(rootPathGates$parent[idx], "/", rootPathGates$node[idx])
}

print(rootPathGates)


# remove markers to gate for
nodes_to_gate = level1_nodes[!(level1_nodes %in% newNodes)]
nodes_to_gate = nodes_to_gate[nodes_to_gate != "CXCR3_dim+"] # manually remove the dim

print(nodes_to_gate)


# store root paths
rootPaths[subsetName] = rootPathGates$flowJoName[nrow(rootPathGates)]
rootPaths[subsetNameAntigenSpecific] = paste0(rootPaths[subsetName], "/", AIMpp_gate$node)
```

```{r previous}
# First, we need to add the CXCR5- gate to our data structures
nodesToAdd = c("CXCR5", "CXCR3") # nodes that need to be negated

filterIdpos = paste0(nodesToAdd, "+")
filterIdneg = paste0(nodesToAdd, "-")

idx = which(gateList$node %in% filterIdpos)

parent = gateList$parent[idx]

flowJoNamePos = paste(parent, filterIdpos, sep = "/")
flowJoNameNeg = paste(parent, filterIdneg, sep = "/")

# setup the gate that will be inserted
filterChar = paste0("`!", filterIdpos, "`")

for (i in 1:length(nodesToAdd)) {
  
  if (filterIdneg[i] %in% gateList$node) {next}
  
  exprs = paste0("!", filterIdpos[i])
  gate_ = eval(substitute(booleanFilter(v, filterId = w), list(v = as.symbol(exprs), w = filterIdneg[i])))
  
  gateList = rbind(gateList, data.frame(flowJoName = flowJoNameNeg[i], node = filterIdneg[i], parent = parent[i], idx = nrow(gateList)+1 ))
  
  for (condition_ in unique(design$condition)) {
    for (batch_ in unique(design$batch)) {
      gates[[condition_]][[batch_]] = c(gates[[condition_]][[batch_]], gate_)
    }
  }
  
}

gateList$flowJoName[1:14]

# rootpath
rootPathGates = rbind(gateList[c(1:11,13,14),], dplyr::filter(gateList, node %in% c("CD4_RO+") )) # root path for the CD4+ RO+ cells

# now add the THF Th17 node
newNodes = c("CXCR5+", "CXCR5-", "CXCR3+", "CXCR3-", "CCR6+") # the negative node must be next to the positive of its kind
rootPathGates = rbind(rootPathGates, gateList[match(newNodes, gateList$node), ])

for (i in 1:length(newNodes)) {
  idx = which(rootPathGates$node == newNodes[i])
  if (str_detect(newNodes[i], "-") ) { # if is a negative gate, we will take the root path from two above.
      rootPathGates$parent[idx] = rootPathGates$parent[idx-1]
    } else { # else we take the node name
      rootPathGates$parent[idx] = rootPathGates$flowJoName[idx-1]
    } 
  rootPathGates$flowJoName[idx] = paste0(rootPathGates$parent[idx], "/", rootPathGates$node[idx])
}

print(rootPathGates)


# remove markers to gate for
nodes_to_gate = level1_nodes[!(level1_nodes %in% newNodes)]
nodes_to_gate = nodes_to_gate[nodes_to_gate != "CXCR3_dim+"] # manually remove the dim

print(nodes_to_gate)


# store root paths
rootPaths[subsetName] = rootPathGates$flowJoName[nrow(rootPathGates)]
rootPaths[subsetNameAntigenSpecific] = paste0(rootPaths[subsetName], "/", AIMpp_gate$node)
```
